notes.title: Microphone Selection - Update
notes.notes:
Hello there!
We've just released an update that brings lots of new features and fixes. One of them is microphone selection, which a lot of people have been asking for for a long time.

BloodLight is running on a new version of the Unreal Engine, version 5.3 to be exact. This upgrade has allowed us to create a microphone selection, which you can now find in the settings under the audio category.

What does the update bring?
Besides setting up the microphone selection, the update fixes a lot of bugs but also removed a lot of features. The game contained a lot of unnecessary or even redundant features that have been removed due to a problem with these features.

There will be plenty of updates coming out in the coming days to improve the game and prepare for the full release.

When will the game be released?
Helloween is approaching and Galactic Games is working on new games and updates. So we could say that the full game will be released in the next few weeks.

- Team Galactic Games

notes.title: BloodLight - Patch BETA 9.0.2
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we are releasing a new patch BETA 9.0.2.

Here are all the changes made:

 Fixed setting defaults in controls settings.
 Fixed setting default values in video settings for Shader Quality and Reflection.
 Enlarged player's hit box (due to not being able to see through walls)
 Fixed cracking volume adjustment
 Fixed generator collisions
 Temporarily disabled one of the 11 tasks. Current number of tasks: 10
 Monster can hear at 0.75 times less distance.
 Wait time for the next task has been increased from 10 to 15
 Added new door system (doors only open or close with interact)
 Added "You Died" message when player died

Thank you for still supporting us! We are trying to improve the game as much as we can. If anyone has any ideas on what to fix, add or remove, please contact us: https://galacticgames.site/contact
